title: pvCellGridProbe
body:
## pvCellGridProbe

Probes a cell grid (Source port, vtkCellGrid) at the points of a polydata (Input port): the output polydata keeps the probe points that lie inside cells of the cell grid, with the chosen cell-grid attribute interpolated to them. A point inside several overlapping cells, typically on a shared boundary, appears once per cell. Use it to sample DG or other cell-grid fields along lines or at locations; for ordinary datasets use resample, pvResampleWithDataset or probeLine.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Probe points outside the cell grid are dropped, so the output can have fewer points than the probe input.
- Repeated points on cell boundaries bias averages; remove or account for them before summarizing.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `CellGridProbe`. Identity: `filters/CellGridPointProbe`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

ParaView: An input polydata to use as a probe. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

ParaView: An input cell-grid to probe. Accepted data: cell grids (discontinuous Galerkin cells) (vtkCellGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkCellGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
